solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One's king toppled to form republic

parts.note: one is I, and the 's adds an S, giving I'S

indicators.note: a toppled king falls over, so the king's name is read backwards in a down-up sense

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's tragic king

explanation.surface: A monarch is overthrown so that the state can become a republic.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down-the-page sense 'toppled' sends the king's name tumbling backwards; 'One's' supplies I plus the possessive S.
explanation.definitionFit: The Middle Eastern state is a parliamentary republic, so it is an example of one.

clue.text: Where striker stands for more pay

definitions.meaning: in cricket the batsman (striker) stands in the crease, the marked line at the wicket

explanation.surface: A striking worker holds out for a pay rise.
explanation.walkthrough: The striker is not a picketing worker but the batsman facing the bowling in cricket, who stands 'in crease'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pay rise is an addition to wages; the cricket sense splits the word as a preposition plus noun.

clue.text: It aids digestion when you have a hard time

parts.note: a hard time is a rough one
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Something helps the stomach when life is tough.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietary fibre, which keeps the gut moving, is the food component that helps digestion.

clue.text: A head surrounded by teachers

indicators.note: the word teachers surrounds the letters wanted, which sit within it

explanation.surface: A headteacher is surrounded by staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Priced 'a head' means per person, the same as so much apiece for every one.

clue.text: Moving film, say, about English insects with short lives

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go about, around, the E
moving the letters of film and say about rearranges them

explanation.surface: A moving film, perhaps, about English insects that live only briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film, say' looks like a cinema example, but both words are anagram fodder for 'Moving', and the result goes 'about' the single letter for English.
explanation.definitionFit: Adult ephemeroptera famously live only a day or so after emerging, so they are short-lived insects.

clue.text: Plans to give scope to people in the arts

indicators.note: the scope and the people are put in the word arts

parts.note: taken as written
range means scope or extent
men are people

explanation.surface: Plans to give arts workers more freedom.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrangements are plans or preparations made for something.

clue.text: Effrontery, more than cheek

definitions.meaning: nerve or impudence, as in having the nerve to do something
the whole front of the head contains the cheeks, so it is more than a cheek

explanation.surface: Effrontery that goes beyond mere cheekiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Both cheek and its bigger partner mean impudence, and anatomically the cheek is just one part of the front of the head.

clue.text: Transfix politician caught in a lie, perhaps

indicators.note: the politician is trapped inside the other letters
perhaps suggests the letters of a lie may be arranged some other way

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Pin down a politician caught out telling a lie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges A LIE into IALE, and MP is 'caught in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: To transfix is to pierce through with something sharp, the same as skewering on a spike.

clue.text: Is a member of a board and delays decisions

definitions.text: Is a member of a board
definitions.meaning: to serve on a committee or panel
to hold back on something without acting

explanation.surface: A board member who puts off making decisions.
explanation.definitionFit: Serving on a committee and leaving a matter unresolved are both expressed by the same phrasal verb.

clue.text: Eggs used for a change?

definitions.meaning: a set of eggs laid together in a nest
the pedal pressed to change gear in a car

explanation.surface: Eggs being used to make a change from the usual.
explanation.definitionFit: A hen's set of eggs and the car pedal for changing gear share the name.

clue.text: It's crazy, using hard and soft drugs together

parts.note: crack cocaine is a hard drug
pot, cannabis, is a soft drug

explanation.surface: Mixing hard and soft drugs is madness.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot idea is eccentric or mad; the word works as an adjective meaning crazy.

clue.text: Be subject to joint French and German articles

parts.note: a knuckle is a finger joint
un is the French indefinite article
der is a German definite article

explanation.surface: A joint venture subject to French and German articles of agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To submit or give in to authority is to accept being subject to it.

clue.text: What one said after reflection

parts.note: after thinking it over, it seems, but really sound bounced back off a surface repeats what was said

explanation.definitionFit: A reverberation repeats a call after it is reflected off a wall or cliff.

clue.text: Silly girl that is going out

indicators.note: the abbreviation goes outside the girl's name

parts.note: ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is
Nan is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A silly girl who is heading out for the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane remarks are pointless and foolish, which is silly.

clue.text: This singer develops a lot

indicators.note: develops suggests the letters of a lot grow into a new form

explanation.surface: This vocalist improves a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A low female or high male voice part names a type of singer.

clue.text: Take things the wrong way?

parts.note: seems to mean misunderstand, but taking things wrongfully is theft

explanation.definitionFit: Theft is taking possessions dishonestly, the wrong way to obtain them.

clue.text: A record number of contestants in the field

definitions.meaning: an item written in a register or diary

definitions.text: number of contestants in the field
definitions.meaning: the total of competitors entered for an event

explanation.surface: A record turnout of competitors in the race.
explanation.definitionFit: An item in a log, and the list of runners for a race, are both called by this noun.

clue.text: They help strikers to see the delivery men

definitions.text: They help strikers to see the delivery men

parts.words: They help strikers to see the delivery men
parts.note: seems to be about workers on strike, but in cricket white boards behind the bowler let the batsman see the ball delivered

explanation.surface: Something helping striking workers to spot the delivery drivers.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the striker is the batsman and the delivery is the bowler's ball; large white screens behind the bowler make the ball visible.
explanation.definitionFit: Boundary screens give batsmen a plain background so they can see the bowler's arm and the ball.

clue.text: Taking someone on of attractive disposition

explanation.surface: Hiring someone with a pleasant personality.
explanation.definitionFit: Hiring a worker and being charming are both senses of the same participle.

clue.text: Ill-disposed ladies to be separated

indicators.note: ill-disposed letters are badly placed, so ladies to is rearranged

explanation.surface: Unfriendly women are to be kept apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Something set apart or cut off from others has been separated.

clue.text: They prevent friction when put in a race

definitions.text: They prevent friction when put in a race

parts.words: They prevent friction when put in a race
parts.note: sounds like calming rivals in a contest, but a race is also the grooved ring in which small steel spheres roll

explanation.surface: Something placed among competitors to stop quarrels.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'race' in engineering is the track holding the rolling spheres of a bearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardened steel spheres set in a grooved ring let shafts turn with little friction.

clue.text: A 19 billion miles right in outer space?

indicators.note: the right goes in the rearranged letters
outer read as out-er, something out of order, rearranges the word space

explanation.surface: A vast distance, set right out in deep space.
explanation.walkthrough: '19' here is a number, not a cross-reference; 'outer' turns SPACE into PASEC, and 'in' puts R inside. The old British billion was a million million.
explanation.definitionFit: An astronomical unit of distance of about 3.26 light years, roughly nineteen million million miles.

clue.text: Pea soup everyone sent back — another dish wanted

indicators.note: the letters of pea are stirred into a soup, a mixture
the word for everyone is sent back, reading in reverse

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Diners send back the pea soup and ask for a different course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soup' mixes PEA to PAE; 'sent back' turns ALL into LLA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish rice dish with seafood is a different meal from the soup in the surface.

clue.text: A mother for one who was motherless

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, such as a horse

explanation.surface: A mother substitute for an orphan.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the first man was created directly by God, so he had no mother.

clue.text: Glass holder

parts.note: suggests a cup-holder, but glazier's paste holds panes of glass in window frames

explanation.definitionFit: The soft paste that sets around window panes keeps the glazing fixed in its frame.

clue.text: Bouncer for the dance

definitions.meaning: something that bounces, like a sphere used in games

explanation.surface: A doorman working at the dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A bouncing toy sphere and a formal dancing party share the name.

clue.text: Finish second best

parts.note: top means best

explanation.surface: Come in second at the finish line.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring something to an end or cease is to finish.

clue.text: University chaps are first to be ordered off

indicators.note: the chaps come first, ahead of the university letter

parts.note: chaps are men

explanation.surface: University men are the first to be sent off the field.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill of fare lists the dishes from which a diner orders.

clue.text: You can't enjoy it in company

definitions.text: You can't enjoy it in company

parts.words: You can't enjoy it in company
parts.note: being alone is by definition lost once others are present

explanation.definitionFit: Being alone ends the moment someone joins you.

clue.text: Clear half the street

parts.note: demi is a prefix meaning half
St is the abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: Clear half the street of traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove condensation from a windscreen is to clear it.

clue.text: Firm needing a line to Shanghai, say, in China

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
Shanghai is an example of a port

explanation.surface: A company needing a shipping line to Shanghai in China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' is not the country but porcelain: the name is a Shropshire porcelain maker.
explanation.definitionFit: A brand of English porcelain tableware, so an example of fine china.

clue.text: Held in great affection

parts.note: seems to mean much loved, but literally describes someone clasped in a warm embrace

explanation.definitionFit: Being clasped tightly in someone's arms is being held affectionately.
